description: The rest of an on-chain underpayment (SPEC.md §31, The rest of an underpayment). `keys`: the rest key, secret, author and encryption key of an order's (`ref`) invoice with a deposit address (`address`) and an end (`expiresAt`), from `integrationKey` (the app's vector's), the rest record address of each payment hash, and the acceptance record address (SPEC.md §31, Acceptance records). `records`: rest records of the invoice `link` of the order ORD-1042 (the first of `keys`), made with fixed random bytes, as the page of a checkout link of the invoice `link` reads them with `restKey` and `restAuthor`: the invoice it shows (its payment hash, verify URL and sats), "newer" (left aside) or null (ignored). `acceptances`: acceptance records of that invoice, made with fixed random bytes, as the page of a checkout link of an invoice of `link`'s `sats` reads them: what was received (`received`), "newer" (left aside) or null (ignored). `declarations`: declarations of the sale of `ref` (the app's registry), opened as the sale: its invoice, note and `rest` (the invoice it is the rest of: its deposit address and end; null for an invoice of the order), or null (not a declaration of the sale). `asking`: a check of an invoice (`sats`, `expiresAt`) at `now`, which received `received` in time, with the rest invoices the relays hold (`rests`: `id`, payment hash, amount, date, end, and whether it is paid), the sale's lease of the address (`lease`, null without one) and the Lightning address's sendable sats: its `rest` (what is left, and the rest invoice of exactly that, by `id`; null when it has none), and the invoice it asks for (`ask`: its sats and expiry; null when it asks none). A record is of a newer format ("newer") only once its event checks out (SPEC.md §12): one that a relay sends without the rest secret's signature is nothing.
